changes: A broken tab no longer stops Scy from starting; it's skipped and reported
New: optional debug log for troubleshooting (Settings > General)
New: export and import your apps list to back up or share (Settings > Apps & Groups > My apps)
Faster startup: heavy tab work now loads on first visit (~50% quicker launch)
QR code generator: module styles (rounded, extra round, dots) under Advanced options
Apps: add your own apps to the Store via Settings or right-click a search result
Tools: QR advanced options are collapsible and tidier
